entities.name: Magna Carta
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: A charter of liberties agreed to by King John of England at Runnymede in 1215, under pressure from rebel barons. Though initially a feudal document, Magna Carta established the revolutionary principle that the monarch is subject to law. Clauses on habeas corpus, trial by jury, and limits on taxation became the bedrock of English constitutionalism and inspired the U.S. Bill of Rights.
